items.name: UpliftAssumptions

rows.text: • T is transverse, L runs from End Bent 1 toward End Bent 2, and V is upward; axes are right-handed. B− and B+ are at negative and positive transverse coordinates. Reactions are positive in compression.

• The deck and diaphragms distribute global transverse overturning to the beam lines. Girders are simply supported for vertical load; deck continuity at the pier does not impose girder flexural continuity.

• Uniform equivalent loads use the project span and tributary-length definitions. Equal transverse DC/DW distribution, level bearing reaction planes and common end-section geometry are adopted. Local thickened-end weight is not credited.

• C004 uses the explicitly perpendicular horizontal case from LRFD Table 3.8.1.2.3a-1 . C002’s simplified transverse/longitudinal combination remains a separate load case; do not merge its independent components into these rows.

rows.text: COMPLETE CONCURRENT PIER LOAD SET — APPLY ONCE

• Use the factored downward node loads below at transverse coordinates minus and plus half the beam spacing, at the pier centerline and cap-reference elevation. They replace the corresponding DC/DW-plus-wind vertical totals; they are not additional gravity loads.

• Apply the transverse force at the cap reference (or split it equally between these two nodes). Apply the residual moments once. The transverse reaction difference already carries the bearing-level overturning moment.
• Do not also apply C002’s full superstructure cap moment or repeat the vertical wind. Wind on the pier itself remains a separate same-direction load; cap and pier-wall self weight remain in FBMP.

• Physical node IDs and model axis mapping are not supplied. The transfer uses the C002 simple-span horizontal sharing assumption and requires confirmation against the actual bearing restraints and model.
